title: Spotlight is indexing
explanation: macOS is rebuilding its search index, usually after an update or when a new disk is connected.
typical_behavior: Stops on its own, from a few minutes to a few hours.

title: macOS is protecting the CPU
explanation: kernel_task takes CPU time to keep the chip cool when it gets hot.
typical_behavior: Stops when the Mac cools down.

title: The window server is busy
explanation: It draws everything on screen. High CPU usually means a lot of animation, a very large display, or a misbehaving app.

title: Photos is analyzing your library
explanation: Faces, scenes and duplicates are found in the background after importing new photos.

title: Time Machine is backing up
explanation: A backup is running in the background.

title: macOS is installing updates
explanation: System updates are downloading or being prepared.

title: iCloud is syncing
explanation: Files are uploading or downloading from iCloud Drive or another cloud provider.

title: Docker is running containers
explanation: Containers use a virtual machine, which has its own CPU and memory cost.

title: A Chrome tab or extension is busy
explanation: Each tab and extension runs in its own helper process.
typical_behavior: Follows the pages you have open.

title: Xcode is compiling
explanation: Code completion and builds run in background services.
typical_behavior: Ends when the build or the indexing finishes.

title: An Xcode build is running
explanation: Interface Builder and asset compilation are part of the build.

title: A JavaScript process is running
explanation: Usually a dev server, a build or a test run started from a terminal.
typical_behavior: Ends when you stop the command.
